get.description: Export a catalog in RDF/XML described with DCAT (Data Catalog Vocabulary). Specific parameters are described here

parameters.name: include_exports
parameters.description: Sets the datasets exports exposed in the DCAT export. By default, all exports are exposed.

legacy.summary: Only expose csv, json and geojson datasets exports

parameters.name: use_labels_in_exports
parameters.description: If set to `true`, this parameter will make distributions output the label of each field rather than its name. This parameter only applies on distributions that contain a list of the fields in their output (e.g., CSV, XLSX).
